items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The band with, what's her name? Wally Rankin. ... He's a great saxophone player.

ctx.x: Who of your sisters used to work with bands over there?
Well, I had my baby sister. She'd wake. The band with, what's her name? Wally Rankin. What's her name? Wally Rankin. He's a great saxophone player. Huh?
I was with him too. I was with him too. I was with him too.
